This Creamy Chicken and Tortellini Skillet is about to be your new weeknight obsession! Seasoned chicken, plump cheese tortellini, sweet onions, and garlic come together in a velvety Parmesan cream sauce with a healthy dose of spinach. Plus, it goes from skillet to table in under 30 minutes! 🍲

Comment RECIPE and we’ll DM it to you (make sure you’re following us to get it), or grab it at the link in our profile. @budgetbytes

https://www.budgetbytes.com/creamy-chicken-and-tortellini-skillet/".
